## 🛠️ Banco PT — Dashboard Técnico / SRE
Saúde da plataforma, análise de erros e drill-down para investigação.
**Atualização contínua** · timeframe global aplica a tiles sem janela fixa.

1.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count(), ok = countIf(status == "success")
| fieldsAdd health = round(toDouble(ok)/toDouble(total)*100, decimals: 2)
| fields health
1.title: 🟢 Health Score (5min)

2.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95)
2.title: ⚡ Latência P95 agora (5min)

3.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| summarize erros = count()
3.title: 🔴 Erros nos últimos 5 min

4.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count()
| fieldsAdd tpm = total / 5
| fields tpm
4.title: 📊 Volume agora (txn/min)

5.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count(), ok = countIf(status == "success"), by:{canal}
| fieldsAdd sla = toDouble(ok)/toDouble(total)*100
| filter sla < 99.9
| summarize canais_degradados = count()
5.title: ❗ Canais com SLA degradado (1h)

6.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-5m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| filter toLong(latencia_ms) > 2000
| summarize outliers = count()
6.title: 🐌 Outliers de latência (>2s, 5min)

8.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize volume = count(), ok = countIf(status == "success"), erros = countIf(status == "error"), p50 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), p99 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 99), by:{canal}
| fieldsAdd sucesso_pct = round(toDouble(ok)/toDouble(volume)*100, decimals: 2)
| fields canal, volume, sucesso_pct, erros, p50, p95, p99
| sort sucesso_pct
8.title: Status detalhado por canal (1h)

9.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| summarize total = count(), ok = countIf(status == "success"), by:{canal, bin(timestamp, 2m)}
| fieldsAdd sla = round(toDouble(ok)/toDouble(total)*100, decimals: 2)
| fields timestamp, canal, sla
9.title: Taxa de sucesso por canal — 1h

11.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| summarize erros = count(), by:{bin(timestamp, 1m)}
11.title: Erros por minuto (1h)

12.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(error_code)
| summarize ocorrencias = count(), by:{codigo = error_code}
| sort ocorrencias, direction:"descending"
| limit 10
12.title: Top códigos de erro (1h)

13.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(error_code)
| summarize ocorrencias = count(), p95_latencia = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), valor_perdido_eur = round(sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), by:{canal, codigo = error_code}
| sort ocorrencias, direction:"descending"
13.title: Distribuição canal × código de erro (1h)

14.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(error_code)
| summarize ocorrencias = count(), by:{codigo = error_code, bin(timestamp, 2m)}
14.title: Códigos de erro ao longo do tempo (1h)

16.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p50 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 50), p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), p99 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 99), by:{bin(timestamp, 1m)}
16.title: Latência P50 / P95 / P99 global (1h)

17.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), by:{canal, bin(timestamp, 2m)}
17.title: P95 por canal ao longo do tempo (1h)

18.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| summarize p50 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 50), p75 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 75), p90 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 90), p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), p99 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 99), max_ms = max(toLong(latencia_ms)), by:{canal}
| sort p99, direction:"descending"
18.title: Distribuição de latência por canal (1h)

19.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| filter isNotNull(servico)
| summarize p95 = percentile(toLong(latencia_ms), 95), volume = count(), by:{servico, canal}
| filter volume > 5
| sort p95, direction:"descending"
| limit 15
19.title: Serviços mais lentos (P95, 1h)

21.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-30m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| fields timestamp, canal, servico, error_code, error_message, latencia_ms, valor_eur, iban = iban_origem, transaction_id
| sort timestamp, direction:"descending"
| limit 30
21.title: Últimas 30 transações com erro

22.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(servico)
| summarize ocorrencias = count(), canais_afetados = countDistinctExact(canal), perda_eur = round(sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), by:{servico}
| sort ocorrencias, direction:"descending"
22.title: Erros por serviço — 1h

23.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-30m
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter isNotNull(latencia_ms)
| fields timestamp, canal, servico, latencia_ms, status, valor_eur, transaction_id
| sort toLong(latencia_ms), direction:"descending"
| limit 20
23.title: Transações mais lentas (top 20, 30min)

24.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.core"
| filter status == "error"
| filter isNotNull(iban_origem)
| summarize erros_no_cliente = count(), canais_afetados = countDistinctExact(canal), valor_perdido_eur = round(sum(toDouble(valor_eur)), decimals: 2), by:{iban_origem}
| sort erros_no_cliente, direction:"descending"
| limit 10
24.title: Clientes (IBAN) mais afetados por erros (1h)

26.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.auth"
| filter status == "failed"
| filter isNotNull(pais_origem)
| summarize falhas = count(), ips_distintos = countDistinctExact(ip_origem), by:{pais = pais_origem}
| sort falhas, direction:"descending"
26.title: Falhas de login + país de origem (1h)

27.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` == "banco.fraude"
| summarize tentativas = count(), bloqueadas = countIf(status == "blocked"), valor_bloqueado_eur = round(sum(if(status == "blocked", toDouble(valor_tentado_eur), 0)), decimals: 2), by:{canal, regra}
| sort tentativas, direction:"descending"
27.title: Fraude por canal e regra (1h)

28.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-1h
| filter `event.provider` in ["banco.core", "banco.fraude", "banco.auth"]
| filter status == "error" or status == "failed" or status == "blocked"
| summarize ocorrencias = count(), by:{provider = `event.provider`, status, bin(timestamp, 2m)}
28.title: Eventos críticos correlacionados — 1h (todos os providers)
